_doc: T2.8 calibration corridors — every band is TUNE data (D-006). Two-sided by construction: the battery fails when a metric leaves its band in EITHER direction, and fails when the metric produced no signal at all (no-output-is-failure). Bands were measured on the T2.7b honest dynamics (ADR-011 kernel) and widened to cover seed variance, not to make tests pass: see each band's note.

canonical._doc: Canonical production autoplay (sim autoplay: 1024 px world, N = 12, 650 turns to year 4500). Fed-era corridors: at this scale the world is far below capacity for the whole horizon.

fedGrowthPerYear.note: The ratified T2.7 band 0.05-0.1 %/yr verbatim; measured 0.00072-0.00076 across seeds after the 800-year founding warm-up.

crudeBirthRatePer1000.note: Pre-modern CBR corridor around the measured 41.5; the historical envelope is ~30-55, the tune sits mid-range.

crudeDeathRatePer1000.note: CDR tracks CBR minus the growth band; measured 40.7.

pyramidChildShare.note: Measured 0.410; pre-modern high-fertility pyramids are 0.35-0.45 under-15.

pyramidElderShare.note: Measured 0.026 with the BandViews elder boundary; pre-modern survival past the elder line is rare.

densityPerArableKm2.note: People per fertility-weighted arable km2 at year 4500. BAND UNCHANGED through T3.1 and T3.2b. THE DEVIATION CHANGED SIDES AT T3.2b and the band was still not moved. T3.1 measured 0.1415-0.1630 across four seeds, three of them BELOW the 0.15 floor; T3.2b measures 2.252 (seed 1) and 2.385 (seed 2), ABOVE the 0.6 ceiling. Same underlying fault both times, and the flip is the evidence that it was a DENOMINATION problem rather than a demographic one: the numerator barely moved, while the denominator fell ~15x when the catchment stopped being a ~205 km isochrone (809,711 fertility-weighted km2 world-wide) and became a 50 km ECONOMIC HINTERLAND (50,516-54,621). WHAT 'ARABLE' MEANS since T3.2b: the sum over lattice blocks inside settlement catchments of (mean agronomic-suitability index) x (block km2) - now computed in km2 at the catchment itself, through the single conversion in LatticeGeometry, rather than in fertility-weighted NODES that one consumer scaled and another did not (CR-002). THE RE-DERIVATION RECORDED AT T3.1 STANDS AND IS WORTH RE-READING NOW: four reference classes and two adversarial reviews refuted a proposed floor of 0.12 (the cancellation identity - deriving a floor through the sim's own measured mean suitability pins it at a fixed fraction of whatever the map reports - is the standing example of a self-referential corridor). That exercise put the honest frontier band at [0.25, 2.30]. The current measurement sits just inside it, at the very top, and outside this standing band. Raising the band to the re-derived one is ALSO a change to the instrument and needs the same director ruling, so it is not done here. The deviation is quarantined with teeth in both directions in CalibrationBatteryTests and escalated in docs/adr/cr-002.md and docs/adr/cr-003.md. CAUTION FOR WHOEVER RULES: population is NOT what moved and is not what this metric is now measuring. Population is set by the demographic vectors integrated over the era table, not by the food ceiling (cr-003 2.3), so this reading is very nearly a statement about catchment GEOMETRY divided into a demography-driven numerator.

migrationGrossPerDecade.note: T3.4b RE-DERIVED, definition first (director ruling). WHAT THIS NUMBER MEASURES, established by measurement not assumption: LONG-DISTANCE PERMANENT INTER-SETTLEMENT RELOCATION between sites spaced >=480 km apart, in a frontier agrarian world with 26x arable-per-capita heterogeneity and rain-fed harvest CV 0.30, with no trade and foot/cart transport. It is NOT a migration propensity: baseRatePerYear 0.03/0.018/0.012 gives 0.43/0.41/0.42 %/decade, barely moving and non-monotonically, because the T2.8 gap-closing cap binds and m* = (R_j*P_i - R_i*P_j)/(R_i+R_j) depends only on resources and population - the rate cancels out entirely. T3.4c CORRECTION (review fix, measured): the number is NOT set by land heterogeneity — that attribution was refuted by factorial at corrected variance (canonical seed 1, 650 turns): sigma swept 0->0.5 moves the corridor 3.70x (0.000671->0.002480 %/decade) while the land term's entire main effect is 2.0% and deleting it outright moves the value -0.8%; at sigma=0 the shipped world reads 33% BELOW this floor. The number is set by WEATHER-DRIVEN per-capita food differentials against the cap. (The baseRatePerYear probe above was taken at sigma=0.18, pre-derivation; the cancellation it demonstrates is structural and survives the variance fix.) PRIOR BASIS (superseded): the old note read 'measured 0.0004 in the fed era ... upper edge = the T2.5 rig corridor ceiling' - i.e. the band was FITTED to what the model happened to produce and borrowed its ceiling from another rig. It was never derived. REFERENCE CLASS: frontier agrarian colonization - LBK Neolithic spread across Europe, Bantu expansion, the Russian/Siberian agricultural frontier, the North American colonial interior. Societies where land is abundant, sites differ markedly in quality, and long-distance relocation is expensive but routinely undertaken. BAND THE CLASS IMPLIES: lower bound 0.1 %/decade - below this a 26x land-quality differential is never exploited, settlements are isolated islands and no frontier dynamic exists, which contradicts every member of the class. Upper bound 1.0 %/decade - above this, 10% of a population relocates 480+ km per century on foot, with no markets, no roads to speak of and no surplus to finance it; subsistence societies cannot sustain that rate of long-distance movement. Hence [0.001, 0.010]. EPISTEMIC CAVEAT, stated because it matters: this band was derived AFTER the value 0.76 %/decade was measured, so it was not derived blind. (PROVENANCE, T3.4c: 0.76 was measured in the pre-fix world whose realised sigma was inflated 1.10-1.41x; the corrected world measures 0.115-0.164 %/decade on canonical seeds 1-5. The caveat's point — the band was not derived blind — stands unchanged; the number is kept as the historical value the derivation knew.) The two bounds rest on land-exploitation and transport-cost arguments that are independent of the measurement, but the director should weigh that the number was known.

dev._doc: Dev-world autoplay (256 px, N = 4, 1000 turns): the capacity horizon is reachable, so the Malthus corridors live here.

crashCount.note: At least one >=20% boom-crash must occur (measured: exactly 1 per seed, first at t ~ 590-660); more than 3 in 1000 turns would be the oscillation pathology, not the Malthus cycle.

firstCrashTurn.note: RE-BANDED at T3.1 (was [400,800], measured 255-535 on M2 dynamics): the worldgen refresh moved it - river valleys are moist now (moisture BFS credits riverbanks), so catchment fertility and carrying capacity rose world-wide and the growth-to-overshoot arc lengthened. Measured on the refreshed dynamics: 806 (seed 7), 826 (seed 42); band covers seed variance with margin. T3.10 re-examines with the goods economy in place.

crashDepth.note: Measured 0.71-0.83 peak-to-trough; a <0.4 dip is a wobble not a crash, >0.95 is extinction.

postCrashPopulation.note: The survivors must oscillate around capacity (~10.2k measured 10.2-11.6k final), not die out and not re-boom past the peak.

starvationRatePer1000.note: Whole-run starvation deaths per 1000 person-years (measured 0.42-0.44): famine demography must EXIST (zero means the crash was bloodless = dodge regression) and must not dominate base mortality.

migrationGrossPerDecade.note: T3.4b: unified with the canonical band, which is now DERIVED from the frontier-agrarian reference class rather than fitted per-world. The dev band was previously [0.0005, 0.01] - its upper edge already coincided with the derived ceiling. RE-FRAMED 2026-07-27 (director ruling): this floor is NOT missed by one outlier seed. MEASURED, dev worldgen, 1000 turns, seeds 1-60: 52 of 60 sit BELOW this floor, 8 in band, and 10 fall in the [0.9*lo, lo) window the test quarantines. Worst seed 26 at 0.00044986 (-55.0%); median seed 54 at 0.000858572 (-14.1%); best seed 14 at 0.00115079 (+15.1%). The ratified seed 7 sits at 0.000956939 (-4.3%) - the 44th smallest of 60, i.e. among the SMALLEST misses, not an outlier. THE WHOLE DEV SEED SET STRADDLES THIS FLOOR. THE FLOOR DOES NOT MOVE: this is a description fix, not a band fix, and the T3.4b ruling against widening stands. T3.4c's re-measurement in the variance-corrected world is judged against this baseline - the weather defect inflated realised sigma ~1.33x and gross migration with it, so a quarantine that hid the majority of its own failures would have made those before/after deltas meaningless.
